turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Hi there, how are you feeling now after the surgery?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: I'm okay, I guess. Still a bit groggy, but I can talk.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: That's expected. On a scale from 0 to 10, how would you rate your pain right now?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Maybe a 3 or 4. There's some discomfort, but it's manageable.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Good. Have you felt nauseous at all since waking up?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: No, not really. My stomach feels fine so far.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Excellent. How's your breathing? Any tightness or difficulty catching your breath?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: No, I'm breathing fine. Just a bit tired from the anesthesia, I think.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Understood. Do you remember anything from the operating room today?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Not really. I remember going in and then waking up here. So I guess I was out completely.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: That's normal with general anesthesia. Given your diabetes and weight, we'll keep a close eye on your sugar levels and mobility post-op. Any concerns or questions from your side?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: No, I think that's all. I just want to go home soon and rest.
